reasoningSteps: Coordinate model and scope: Place the bolt at the origin and the handle along +x; the applied force points 30 degrees counterclockwise from +x.

Worked synthetic case: tau_z=0.40(30)sin(30 degrees)=+6.00 N·m; the radial component 30cos(30 degrees) does not turn the bolt.
Independent check: Resolve F_y=15 N and calculate r_x F_y=0.40(15)=+6.00 N·m; verify N·m rather than N/m.
Falsifiable counterexample: Using r F=12 N·m falsely assumes a 90-degree push; the bolt reaction and friction are outside this applied-torque calculation.

Controlled sensitivity and evidence: Hold 30 N fixed and rotate the push to 90 degrees: tau becomes +12.00 N·m, twice the angled trial.
